description:
Download manager based on aria2.

Varia is a simple download manager. It uses the amazing aria2 to handle the downloads.
It supports basic functionality like continuing incomplete downloads from the previous session upon startup, pausing/cancelling all downloads at once, setting a speed limit, authentication with a username/password, setting the simultaneous download amount and setting the download directory.
- Option to show save dialog on every download
- Switch to aria2-next and (on Linux) QuickJS
- Tweaks for macOS: Better tray icon and headerbar
- Remote mode tweaks for better legibility
- Update to the GNOME 51 runtime
- Bug fix: Torrent file selection dialog can now scroll
- Bug fix: Opening large .torrent files no longer fail
- Bug fix: File name too long error on macOS fixed
- Bug fix: Torrent seeding ratio setting no longer causes crashes
- Bug fix: Speed limit setting no longer causes crashes
- Bug fix: Fixed torrents auto-restarting when paused and speed at 0B/s or when re-added with paused set to true
Notice for macOS users on Intel: This version is not available on Intel Macs. That doesn't mean Intel support is dropped, it's due to several issues relating to building Intel binaries. For now keep using the older version.
